'''Bellows''' was a [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] who served in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Bellows suffered severe head trauma just before [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]] was issued and was found by [[Lira Hardin/Legends|Lira Hardin]]. Unaware of Order 66 and why is fellow [[Cloning|clone]] brothers were behaving differently, Lira convinced him to go into hiding. Bellows was named [[Chief of Security/Legends|security chief]] of [[Foundry Four/Legends|Foundry Four]] and worked alongside his second-in-command, a [[Besalisk/Legends|Besalisk]] [[Security officer/Legends|security officer]] named [[Rybo/Legends|Rybo]].<ref name="Friends Like These" />
